clauses.title: Requirements of bare solid
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirements of bare solid filler rods and wires for welding aluminium and aluminium alloys and filler rods for welding magnesium alloys by inert gas tungsten arc welding (TIG) or gas metal arc welding (MIG) processes. The chemical composition of the filler rods and wire is also specified.

clauses.title: The standard does not
clauses.text: 1.2 The standard does not specify the chemical composition and the mechanical properties of the weld deposit.

clauses.title: The rods and wires
clauses.text: 1.3 The rods and wires specified in this standard are all suitable for use with argon or helium or mixture of these gases.

clauses.title: The diameters of rods
clauses.text: 2.1 The diameters of rods and wires shall be as specified below. The tolerances appropriate to the specified diameters are also given. Form Diameter           Tolerances Plus         Minus mm mm mm Wire 0.6 0.01 0.03 0.8 0.01 0.04 1.0 0.01 0.04 Wire and rod 1.2 0.01 0.04 1.6 0.01 0.04 2.0 0.01 0.07 2.4 0.01 0.07 3.2 0.01 0.07 Rod 4.0 0.01 0.07 5.0 0.01 0.07

clauses.title: Lenght of Rods (Cut Lengths)
clauses.text: 2.2 Lenght of Rods (Cut Lengths) — Rods less than 2.5 mm in diameter shall be supplied in lengths of 500 or 1 000 mm. Rods 2.5 mm and larger in diameter shall be supplied in lengths of 1 000 mm.

clauses.title: Tolerance on length shall
clauses.text: 2.2.1 Tolerance on length shall be ±5 mm.

clauses.title: Conditions of Rods and Wires
clauses.text: 3. Conditions of Rods and Wires —Finished filler rods and wires shall have a smooth finish free from surface imperfections, corrosion products, grease, excess oxide or other foreign matter which would adversely affect the properties of the weld or the operation of the welding equipment.

clauses.title: S-A1 19000, S
clauses.text: 4.1 S-A1 19000, S-A1 19500, S-A1 26398,   S-A1 31000, S-A143000, S-A1 53000, S-A 1 55000 and S-A1 55330 for Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy filler rods and wires on the basis of their chemical composition.

clauses.title: Here , S denotes
clauses.text: 4.1.1 Here , S denotes bars, solid rod or wire and A1 for aluminium alloy. The last part  i.e the 5 digit number denotes the IS designation of the material.

clauses.title: S-mg1, S
clauses.text: 4.2 S-mg1, S-mg2, Smg3 and Smg4 for magnesium alloy filler rods. Here S denotes the base solid welding rod and Mg for magnesium alloy. The digit used Indicates the particular chemical composition.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.text: 5. Chemical Composition — Shall be as given in Tables 5 and 6 of the standard.

clauses.title: Usability Test
clauses.text: 6. Usability Test —   Upon welding, the molten metal shall flow freely and uniformly and shall produce a weld bead of uniform  appearance, free from cracks and other deleterious defects. Note 1— For requirements of spool and reeling condition,refer to 5 to 6 of the standard. Note 2— For method of test, refer to the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS  5897 : 1985  Specifications for aluminium and aluminium alloy welding rods and wires and magnesium alloy welding rods (first revision). SUMMARY OF IS 5897 : 1985 ALUMINIUM AND ALUMINIUM ALLOY WELDING RODS AND WIRES AND MAGNESIUM ALLOY WELDING RODS (First Revision)
